name: Matsushiro Castle
description: Matsushiro Castle was the seat of the Sanada domain, famed for the Sengoku-era Sanada clan. The 2011-reconstructed drum gate and moats mark the castle park in the Matsushiro samurai town.
notes: Free to walk the castle grounds; the nearby Matsushiro samurai residences are paid sites.
